## At a glance

| | |
|---|---|
| **Input** | Host or symbiont fraction (or a bead-beaten polyp) in lysis buffer, with known protein content |
| **Output** | Citrate synthase activity (mU mg⁻¹ protein) |
| **Kit** | Sigma-Aldrich Citrate Synthase Assay Kit CS0720 ([manual](/images/SA_Citrate_Synthase_Assay.pdf)) + Pierce BCA kit |
| **Time** | ~1 h for one plate after protein is known (estimate) |
| **Tested on** | *Astrangia poculata* (symbiotic and aposymbiotic), host and symbiont fractions |

Citrate synthase turns acetyl-CoA and oxaloacetate (OAA) into citrate and releases CoA-SH. CoA-SH reacts with DTNB to give a yellow product, measured at 412 nm. The rate measured before OAA is added (baseline) is subtracted from the rate after.

## Materials

- Sigma CS0720 kit: 5× assay buffer, acetyl-CoA, OAA, DTNB, citrate synthase (positive control)
- Pierce BCA Protein Assay Kit ([Total protein protocol](total-protein-bca.qmd))
- 100% ethanol (to dissolve DTNB), DI water
- Lysis buffer (below); bead tubes with 0.1 and 0.5 mm beads (whole polyps)
- 96-well flat-bottom plate, plate reader with kinetic mode at 412 nm, multichannel pipette

## Solutions to prepare

| Solution | Recipe | Storage |
|---|---|---|
| **Lysis buffer** (25 mM Tris pH 7.8, 1 mM EDTA, 10% glycerol) | 100 mL: 2.5 mL 1 M Tris + 0.2 mL 0.5 M EDTA + 10 mL glycerol + 87.3 mL DI water | Room temp |
| **1× assay buffer** | 1 part 5× buffer + 4 parts DI water (e.g. 0.7 mL + 2.8 mL). Make enough for the master mix + OAA + control | Make fresh |
| **Acetyl-CoA, 30 mM** | Dissolve the vial in 1 mL DI water | 200 µL aliquots, −20 °C |
| **DTNB, 10 mM** | Dissolve the vial in 1 mL 100% ethanol | 200 µL aliquots, −20 °C |
| **OAA, 10 mM** | 1.3 mg OAA in 1 mL 1× assay buffer | −20 °C, max 1 week |
| **Positive control** | 2 µL citrate synthase + 60 µL 1× assay buffer | On ice, same day |

## Procedure

### A. Samples and protein

1. **Fractions:** use host and symbiont aliquots from [Part C of the tissue protocol](coral-tissue-removal-homogenization.qmd).
   **Whole polyps:** put a polyp in a bead tube with 500 µL lysis buffer, vortex ~2 min, spin 16,000 × g for 1.5 min and keep the supernatant.
2. Measure protein with BCA on a small aliquot.
3. Dilute each sample so that **20 µL contains 2–6 µg protein** (Hawkins et al. 2016). Samples under 1 µg per 20 µL are too dilute to use.
   - e.g. 0.774 mg mL⁻¹ × 20 µL = 15.5 µg → dilute 3× (6.6 µL sample + 13.4 µL water).
4. Prepare **60 µL per sample** (3 replicate wells × 20 µL). Negative control: 60 µL lysis buffer. Positive control: the diluted citrate synthase.

### B. Reaction

5. Make the master mix: **170 µL per well**:

   | Per well | Final conc. |
   |---|---|
   | 3.3 µL 30 mM acetyl-CoA | ~0.59 mM |
   | 5 µL 10 mM DTNB | ~0.29 mM |
   | 161.7 µL 1× assay buffer | |

   Make ~10–25% extra (e.g. 15 wells' worth for 12 wells).
6. Add **510 µL** master mix (170 µL × 3) to each 60 µL sample/control tube and vortex.
7. Pipette **190 µL** into each of 3 wells.
8. **Baseline:** kinetic read at **412 nm** for ~3 min (e.g. 4 reads, ~49 s apart).
9. Add **10 µL 10 mM OAA** to each well **with a multichannel** so all reactions start together. Pipette-mix.
10. Read again with the same kinetic settings.

### C. Calculate

11. Rate (ΔA412 min⁻¹) after OAA minus the baseline rate, minus the negative control.
12. Convert to activity with the DTNB extinction coefficient and path length as in the kit manual. Normalize to the µg protein in the well and report as mU mg⁻¹ protein.
    Example R scripts: [assay test](https://github.com/kevinhwong1/methods_testing/blob/master/RAnalysis/Scripts/Citrate_Synthase_20190315.R), [Astrangia nutrition](https://github.com/kevinhwong1/Astrangia_Nutrition/blob/master/RAnalysis/Scripts/Citrate_Synthase.R).

## Expected results

| Sample | Activity |
|---|---|
| *A. poculata* symbiotic polyp | 68.9 mU mg⁻¹ |
| *A. poculata* aposymbiotic polyp | 101.5 mU mg⁻¹ |

These are from the [2019 test](../notebook/2019-03-14-citrate-synthase-troubleshooting.md) and fall in the range reported for *Exaiptasia pallida* (Hawkins et al. 2016).

## Troubleshooting

| Problem | Likely cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| No increase after OAA | OAA degraded (unstable once dissolved) | Make OAA fresh, and don't keep it more than a week at −20 °C |
| Reactions in the first columns run ahead | Staggered OAA addition | Add OAA with a multichannel and start reading immediately |
| Too many samples for the kit volumes | One kit covers limited wells | Scale the master mix; 150 wells needed ~24 mL 1× buffer ([2019-05-15](../notebook/2019-05-15-citrate-synthase-for-a-poculata-nutrition-experiment.md)) |
